# ATP Finals Winners List: Every player that has won the tournament by year
## All-Time ATP Finals singles champions
Here is every singles champion of the ATP Finals, year by year, based on the official **Nitto ATP Finals** heritage records.

...

## The meaning of legacy
For many of these winners, the ATP Finals represents both a triumph and a **milestone** . Legends like **Federer, Djokovic** , and **Lendl** built their legacies on dominating this event, while newer champions like **Zverev** and **Medvedev** used it as a personal proof that they can win under pressure.
The **ATP Finals** has served as a stage for the greatest in men's tennis, with the most condecorated champions being **Novak Djokovic** (7 titles), **Roger Federer** (6), **Ivan Lendl** and **Pete Sampras** (5 each).

# The 10 active players with the most ATP titles: Novak Djokovic with 99, Jannik Sinner above Carlos Alcaraz
**[Novak Djokovic](https://www.tennis365.com/tag/novak-djokovic) has won more ATP singles titles than any other active player, while Jannik Sinner and Carlos Alcaraz both make the top 10 of the list.**
Only Jimmy Connors and Roger Federer have won more men’s singles tournaments than Djokovic in the Open Era.
Here are the 10 active players with the most ATP singles titles.

...

## =7. Andrey Rublev – 16
### =7. Carlos Alcaraz – 16
Carlos Alcaraz has won 16 ATP singles tournaments: eight on clay, five on hard courts and three on grass.
The Spaniard’s title tally comprises four Grand Slams, four Masters 1000 crowns, five 500s and two ATP 250s.
He claimed his first-ever title at the 2021 Croatia Open and his most recent at the 2024 China Open.

...

## ATP Features
### =7. Richard Gasquet – 16
#### 6. Jannik Sinner – 18
[Jannik Sinner](https://www.tennis365.com/tag/jannik-sinner) has won 18 ATP singles titles: 16 on hard courts, one on clay and one on grass.
The Italian’s total consists of two Grand Slams, one ATP Finals title, four ATP Masters 1000 crowns, five ATP 500s and six 250 tournaments.

...

#### 3. Alexander Zverev – 23
Alexander Zverev has won 23 ATP singles crowns: 15 hard courts and eight on clay.
The German’s total comprises two ATP Finals titles, an Olympic gold, seven Masters 1000 crowns, five ATP 500 tournaments and eight 250s.

...

#### 1. Novak Djokovic – 99
[Novak Djokovic](https://www.tennis365.com/tag/novak-djokovic) has won 99 ATP singles titles: 71 on hard courts, 20 on clay and eight on grass.
The Serbian’s trophy haul consists of 24 Grand Slams, seven ATP Finals titles, one Olympic gold medal, 40 Masters 1000 crowns, 15 ATP 500s and 12 250s.
He secured his maiden title at the 2006 Dutch Open, while his most recent triumph was at the 2024 Paris Olympic Games.

On this page you will find the complete list of ATP Finals men's singles champions, highlighting the players who have won the most titles throughout the history of this tennis tournament.

In the 56 men's singles finals that have been played at the ATP Finals between 1970 and 2026, a total of **26 players have won the title at least once** . Among these champions, 11 won 2 or more times and 4 did it 5 or more times.

## The players with the most titles
**The most successful player** in ATP Finals history is **Novak Djokovic** with a total of **7 titles** won over a period of 16 years, between 2008 and 2023. **Roger Federer** is second, just 1 title behind, with **6 tournaments** won.

...

These 4 players are the ones with the most finals won at the ATP Finals . Between them, they have won 23 titles, which represents 41.1% of the 56 finals played. These achievements have consolidated these players as the most outstanding in this tournament.
